name: Ling 3.0 Flash Fin
description: Ling 3.0 Flash Fin is a finance-enhanced version of Inclusion AI's Ling 3.0 Flash, a 124B-parameter mixture-of-experts model with approximately 5.1B active parameters. It is optimized for complex, multi-step investment workflows and long-horizon planning while retaining general reasoning, coding, and mathematics capabilities.
